part.text:
Fixed. The issue was in `CreateTargetPaths` (resources/page/page_paths.go:372): `paths.URLEscape`/`paths.PathEscape` use `url.Parse`, which interprets `#` as a fragment delimiter and strips it and everything after it from the link.

The fix escapes `#` as `%23` in the link before it's passed to the escape helpers. The published files keep the literal `#` (e.g. `public/posts/2024/04/newsletter-#4/index.html`), while `.RelPermalink`/`.Permalink` now resolve correctly to `/posts/2024/04/newsletter-%234/`.
